#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

typedef long long ll;

// ---------- InputReader ----------
class InputReader {
private:
    static const int BUFFER_SIZE = 1 << 16;
    char buffer[BUFFER_SIZE];
    int pos, len;
    FILE* stream;
public:
    InputReader(FILE* s = stdin) : stream(s), pos(0), len(0) {}
    int read() {
        if (pos >= len) {
            pos = 0;
            len = fread(buffer, 1, BUFFER_SIZE, stream);
            if (len <= 0) return -1;
        }
        return buffer[pos++];
    }
    int nextInt() {
        int c = read();
        while (isspace(c)) c = read();
        int sgn = 1;
        if (c == '-') { sgn = -1; c = read(); }
        int res = 0;
        do {
            if (c < '0' || c > '9') throw runtime_error("InputMismatchException");
            res = res * 10 + (c - '0');
            c = read();
        } while (!isspace(c));
        return res * sgn;
    }
    string nextString() {
        int c = read();
        while (isspace(c)) c = read();
        string res;
        do {
            res.push_back((char)c);
            c = read();
        } while (!isspace(c));
        return res;
    }
};

// ---------- OutputWriter ----------
class OutputWriter {
private:
    FILE* stream;
public:
    OutputWriter(FILE* s = stdout) : stream(s) {}
    void println(ll x) {
        fprintf(stream, "%lld\n", x);
    }
    void close() {
        fclose(stream);
    }
};

// ---------- Pair ----------
template<typename U, typename V>
struct Pair {
    U first;
    V second;
    Pair(U f, V s) : first(f), second(s) {}
    bool operator<(const Pair& o) const {
        if (first != o.first) return first < o.first;
        return second < o.second;
    }
};

// ---------- IntegerUtils ----------
namespace IntegerUtils {
    int longCompare(ll a, ll b) {
        if (a < b) return -1;
        if (a > b) return 1;
        return 0;
    }
}

// ---------- Heap (binary heap with index map) ----------
class Heap {
private:
    vector<int> elements;
    vector<int> at; // index of element in heap
    int size;
    function<int(int,int)> comparator;
public:
    Heap(int maxElement, function<int(int,int)> comp) : size(0), comparator(comp) {
        elements.reserve(10);
        at.assign(maxElement, -1);
    }
    bool isEmpty() const { return size == 0; }
    void add(int element) {
        if (size == (int)elements.size()) elements.resize(max(2*size, 1));
        elements[size] = element;
        at[element] = size;
        shiftUp(size);
        size++;
    }
    void shiftUp(int index) {
        int value = elements[index];
        while (index > 0) {
            int parent = (index - 1) >> 1;
            int parentValue = elements[parent];
            if (comparator(parentValue, value) <= 0) break;
            elements[index] = parentValue;
            at[parentValue] = index;
            index = parent;
        }
        elements[index] = value;
        at[value] = index;
    }
    void shiftDown(int index) {
        if (index < 0 || index >= size) throw out_of_range("shiftDown");
        while (true) {
            int child = (index << 1) + 1;
            if (child >= size) return;
            if (child + 1 < size && comparator(elements[child], elements[child+1]) > 0) child++;
            if (comparator(elements[index], elements[child]) <= 0) return;
            swap(index, child);
            index = child;
        }
    }
    int getIndex(int element) const { return at[element]; }
    int poll() {
        if (isEmpty()) throw out_of_range("poll");
        int result = elements[0];
        at[result] = -1;
        if (size == 1) {
            size = 0;
            return result;
        }
        elements[0] = elements[--size];
        at[elements[0]] = 0;
        shiftDown(0);
        return result;
    }
private:
    void swap(int i, int j) {
        int temp = elements[i];
        elements[i] = elements[j];
        elements[j] = temp;
        at[elements[i]] = i;
        at[elements[j]] = j;
    }
};

// ---------- Graph ----------
class Graph {
public:
    static const int REMOVED_BIT = 0;
    int vertexCount;
    int edgeCount;
    vector<int> firstOutbound;
    vector<int> firstInbound;
    vector<int> from;
    vector<int> to;
    vector<ll> weight;
    vector<ll> capacity;
    vector<int> reverseEdge;
    vector<int> nextOutbound;
    vector<int> nextInbound;
    vector<int> flags;

    Graph(int vertexCount, int edgeCapacity = -1) : vertexCount(vertexCount), edgeCount(0) {
        if (edgeCapacity == -1) edgeCapacity = vertexCount;
        firstOutbound.assign(vertexCount, -1);
        from.reserve(edgeCapacity);
        to.reserve(edgeCapacity);
        nextOutbound.reserve(edgeCapacity);
        flags.reserve(edgeCapacity);
    }

    int addEdge(int fromID, int toID, ll weightVal, ll capacityVal, int reverseEdgeID) {
        ensureEdgeCapacity(edgeCount + 1);
        if (firstOutbound[fromID] != -1) {
            nextOutbound[edgeCount] = firstOutbound[fromID];
        } else {
            nextOutbound[edgeCount] = -1;
        }
        firstOutbound[fromID] = edgeCount;
        if (!firstInbound.empty()) {
            if (firstInbound[toID] != -1) {
                nextInbound[edgeCount] = firstInbound[toID];
            } else {
                nextInbound[edgeCount] = -1;
            }
            firstInbound[toID] = edgeCount;
        }
        from.push_back(fromID);
        to.push_back(toID);
        if (capacityVal != 0) {
            if (capacity.size() <= (size_t)edgeCount) capacity.resize(edgeCount+1, 0);
            capacity[edgeCount] = capacityVal;
        }
        if (weightVal != 0) {
            if (weight.size() <= (size_t)edgeCount) weight.resize(edgeCount+1, 0);
            weight[edgeCount] = weightVal;
        }
        if (reverseEdgeID != -1) {
            if (reverseEdge.size() <= (size_t)edgeCount) reverseEdge.resize(edgeCount+1, -1);
            reverseEdge[edgeCount] = reverseEdgeID;
        }
        return edgeCount++;
    }

    int addFlowWeightedEdge(int from, int to, ll weightVal, ll capacityVal) {
        if (capacityVal == 0) {
            return addEdge(from, to, weightVal, 0, -1);
        } else {
            int lastEdgeCount = edgeCount;
            addEdge(to, from, -weightVal, 0, lastEdgeCount + 1);
            return addEdge(from, to, weightVal, capacityVal, lastEdgeCount);
        }
    }

    int firstOutboundEdge(int vertex) {
        int id = firstOutbound[vertex];
        while (id != -1 && isRemoved(id)) id = nextOutbound[id];
        return id;
    }

    int nextOutboundEdge(int id) {
        id = nextOutbound[id];
        while (id != -1 && isRemoved(id)) id = nextOutbound[id];
        return id;
    }

    int source(int id) const { return from[id]; }
    int destination(int id) const { return to[id]; }
    ll weightVal(int id) const { return (id < (int)weight.size()) ? weight[id] : 0; }
    ll capacityVal(int id) const { return (id < (int)capacity.size()) ? capacity[id] : 0; }
    ll flow(int id) const {
        if (reverseEdge.empty() || id >= (int)reverseEdge.size() || reverseEdge[id] == -1) return 0;
        return capacity[reverseEdge[id]];
    }
    void pushFlow(int id, ll flowVal) {
        if (flowVal == 0) return;
        if (flowVal > 0) {
            if (capacityVal(id) < flowVal) throw invalid_argument("Not enough capacity");
        } else {
            if (flow(id) < -flowVal) throw invalid_argument("Not enough capacity");
        }
        capacity[id] -= flowVal;
        capacity[reverseEdge[id]] += flowVal;
    }

    bool flag(int id, int bit) const {
        return (flags[id] >> bit) & 1;
    }
    bool isRemoved(int id) const { return flag(id, REMOVED_BIT); }

    bool isSparse() const {
        return vertexCount == 0 || edgeCount * 20 / vertexCount <= vertexCount;
    }

private:
    void ensureEdgeCapacity(int size) {
        if (from.size() < (size_t)size) {
            int newSize = max(size, 2 * (int)from.size());
            from.resize(newSize);
            to.resize(newSize);
            nextOutbound.resize(newSize);
            if (!nextInbound.empty()) nextInbound.resize(newSize);
            if (!weight.empty()) weight.resize(newSize);
            if (!capacity.empty()) capacity.resize(newSize);
            if (!reverseEdge.empty()) reverseEdge.resize(newSize);
            flags.resize(newSize);
        }
    }
};

// ---------- MinCostFlow ----------
class MinCostFlow {
private:
    Graph& graph;
    int source;
    int destination;
    vector<ll> phi;
    vector<ll> dijkstraResult;
    vector<int> lastEdge;
    Heap* heap;
    int vertexCount;
    vector<int> visited;
    int visitIndex;
public:
    MinCostFlow(Graph& g, int s, int d, bool hasNegativeEdges) : graph(g), source(s), destination(d), vertexCount(g.vertexCount), visitIndex(0) {
        phi.assign(vertexCount, 0);
        if (hasNegativeEdges) fordBellman();
        dijkstraResult.assign(vertexCount, 0);
        lastEdge.assign(vertexCount, -1);
        if (graph.isSparse()) {
            heap = new Heap(vertexCount, [this](int a, int b) {
                return IntegerUtils::longCompare(dijkstraResult[a], dijkstraResult[b]);
            });
            visited.clear();
        } else {
            heap = nullptr;
            visited.assign(vertexCount, 0);
        }
    }

    ~MinCostFlow() { delete heap; }

    Pair<ll,ll> minCostMaxFlow() {
        return minCostMaxFlow(LLONG_MAX);
    }

    Pair<ll,ll> minCostMaxFlow(ll maxFlow) {
        ll cost = 0;
        ll flow = 0;
        while (maxFlow != 0) {
            if (graph.isSparse()) {
                dijkstraAlgorithm();
            } else {
                dijkstraAlgorithmFull();
            }
            if (lastEdge[destination] == -1) {
                return Pair<ll,ll>(cost, flow);
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < vertexCount; i++) {
                if (dijkstraResult[i] != LLONG_MAX) {
                    phi[i] += dijkstraResult[i];
                }
            }
            int vertex = destination;
            ll currentFlow = maxFlow;
            ll currentCost = 0;
            while (vertex != source) {
                int edgeID = lastEdge[vertex];
                currentFlow = min(currentFlow, graph.capacityVal(edgeID));
                currentCost += graph.weightVal(edgeID);
                vertex = graph.source(edgeID);
            }
            maxFlow -= currentFlow;
            cost += currentCost * currentFlow;
            flow += currentFlow;
            vertex = destination;
            while (vertex != source) {
                int edgeID = lastEdge[vertex];
                graph.pushFlow(edgeID, currentFlow);
                vertex = graph.source(edgeID);
            }
        }
        return Pair<ll,ll>(cost, flow);
    }

private:
    void fordBellman() {
        fill(phi.begin(), phi.end(), LLONG_MAX);
        phi[source] = 0;
        vector<bool> inQueue(vertexCount, false);
        vector<int> queue(vertexCount + 1);
        queue[0] = source;
        inQueue[source] = true;
        int stepCount = 0;
        int head = 0;
        int end = 1;
        int maxSteps = 2 * vertexCount * vertexCount;
        while (head != end) {
            int vertex = queue[head++];
            if (head == (int)queue.size()) head = 0;
            inQueue[vertex] = false;
            int edgeID = graph.firstOutboundEdge(vertex);
            while (edgeID != -1) {
                ll total = phi[vertex] + graph.weightVal(edgeID);
                int dest = graph.destination(edgeID);
                if (graph.capacityVal(edgeID) != 0 && phi[dest] > total) {
                    phi[dest] = total;
                    if (!inQueue[dest]) {
                        queue[end++] = dest;
                        inQueue[dest] = true;
                        if (end == (int)queue.size()) end = 0;
                    }
                }
                edgeID = graph.nextOutboundEdge(edgeID);
            }
            if (++stepCount > maxSteps) {
                throw invalid_argument("Graph contains negative cycle");
            }
        }
    }

    void dijkstraAlgorithm() {
        fill(dijkstraResult.begin(), dijkstraResult.end(), LLONG_MAX);
        fill(lastEdge.begin(), lastEdge.end(), -1);
        dijkstraResult[source] = 0;
        heap->add(source);
        while (!heap->isEmpty()) {
            int current = heap->poll();
            int edgeID = graph.firstOutboundEdge(current);
            while (edgeID != -1) {
                if (graph.capacityVal(edgeID) != 0) {
                    int next = graph.destination(edgeID);
                    ll total = graph.weightVal(edgeID) - phi[next] + phi[current] + dijkstraResult[current];
                    if (dijkstraResult[next] > total) {
                        dijkstraResult[next] = total;
                        if (heap->getIndex(next) == -1) {
                            heap->add(next);
                        } else {
                            heap->shiftUp(heap->getIndex(next));
                        }
                        lastEdge[next] = edgeID;
                    }
                }
                edgeID = graph.nextOutboundEdge(edgeID);
            }
        }
    }

    void dijkstraAlgorithmFull() {
        visitIndex++;
        fill(dijkstraResult.begin(), dijkstraResult.end(), LLONG_MAX);
        lastEdge[destination] = -1;
        dijkstraResult[source] = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < vertexCount; i++) {
            int index = -1;
            ll length = LLONG_MAX;
            for (int j = 0; j < vertexCount; j++) {
                if (visited[j] != visitIndex && dijkstraResult[j] < length) {
                    length = dijkstraResult[j];
                    index = j;
                }
            }
            if (index == -1) return;
            visited[index] = visitIndex;
            int edgeID = graph.firstOutboundEdge(index);
            while (edgeID != -1) {
                if (graph.capacityVal(edgeID) != 0) {
                    int next = graph.destination(edgeID);
                    if (visited[next] != visitIndex) {
                        ll total = graph.weightVal(edgeID) - phi[next] + phi[index] + length;
                        if (dijkstraResult[next] > total) {
                            dijkstraResult[next] = total;
                            lastEdge[next] = edgeID;
                        }
                    }
                }
                edgeID = graph.nextOutboundEdge(edgeID);
            }
        }
    }
};

// ---------- TaskF ----------
class TaskF {
public:
    void solve(int testNumber, InputReader& in, OutputWriter& out) {
        int n = in.nextInt();
        string s = in.nextString();
        vector<int> a(n);
        vector<int> cnt(26, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            a[i] = in.nextInt();
            cnt[s[i] - 'a']++;
        }
        Graph g(n + 100);
        int source = n + 100 - 2;
        int target = source + 1;
        for (int i = 0; i * 2 < n; ++i) {
            g.addFlowWeightedEdge(i, target, 0, 2);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < 26; ++i) {
            g.addFlowWeightedEdge(source, i + n, 0, cnt[i]);
            for (int j = 0; j * 2 < n; ++j) {
                if (s[j] == s[n - j - 1]) {
                    ll w = 0;
                    if (s[j] == i + 'a') w = -max(a[j], a[n - j - 1]);
                    g.addFlowWeightedEdge(i + n, j, w, 1);
                } else {
                    ll w = 0;
                    if (s[j] == i + 'a') w -= a[j];
                    if (s[n - j - 1] == i + 'a') w -= a[n - j - 1];
                    g.addFlowWeightedEdge(i + n, j, w, 1);
                }
            }
        }
        MinCostFlow mcmf(g, source, target, true);
        Pair<ll,ll> result = mcmf.minCostMaxFlow();
        out.println(-result.first);
    }
};

// ---------- Main ----------
int main() {
    InputReader in(stdin);
    OutputWriter out(stdout);
    TaskF solver;
    solver.solve(1, in, out);
    out.close();
    return 0;
}
